"""Lossless, verified archival of completed source trees; preserve every original and generated byte."""
import datetime, decimal, gzip, hashlib, json, os, resource, shutil, stat, tarfile
from pathlib import Path
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (256 * 1024**2, 256 * 1024**2))
root = Path.cwd()
group = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup') / Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::', 1)[1].lstrip('/')
assert group.name == os.environ['LASM_RESOURCE_UNIT'] and 0 < int((group/'memory.max').read_text()) <= 10*1024**3
assert (group/'memory.high').read_text().strip() == 'max'
record = root / '.work/product-acceptance/completed-application-deno-source-archive-r1.json'
assert not record.exists()
report = {'scope': 'Lossless archival of completed upstream source trees, including every generated file and original symlink; no test is edited',
          'resourceReport': os.environ['LASM_RESOURCE_REPORT'], 'archiverSource': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'sources': [],
          'restore': 'Extract the recorded source.tar.gz into its campaign directory. Verify each file and link against source-archive-manifest.json; mtimeNs and mode are recorded exactly.'}
def save(): record.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
def sha_stream(stream):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    while block:=stream.read(1024*1024): h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()
def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as f: return sha_stream(f)
def inventory(source):
    paths=[source]
    for parent, dirs, files in os.walk(source, followlinks=False):
        paths.extend(Path(parent)/name for name in dirs+files)
    result={}
    for p in sorted(paths):
        s=p.lstat();row={'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode),'mtimeNs':s.st_mtime_ns,'uid':s.st_uid,'gid':s.st_gid}
        if stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode): row.update(type='file',size=s.st_size,sha256=sha(p))
        elif stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode): row.update(type='symlink',link=os.readlink(p))
        else:
            assert stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode),str(p)
            row['type']='directory'
        result[str(p.relative_to(source.parent))]=row
    return result
campaigns = ['.work/upstream-application-all-deno-r1']
for name in campaigns:
    directory=root/name; source=directory/'source'; execution=directory/'execution.json'
    e=json.loads(execution.read_text());r=json.loads(Path(e['resourceReport']).read_text())
    assert r['unitReleased'] and not r['resourceLimited']
    assert e['execution']['code']==0 and e['registered']==101 and e['counts']=={'passed':97,'upstream-compile-disabled':4}
    assert e['originalSources']['before']['modified']==e['originalSources']['after']['modified']==[]
    assert e['harness']['changed']==[]
    archive=directory/'source.tar.gz';partial=directory/'source.tar.gz.partial'; manifest=directory/'source-archive-manifest.json'
    assert source.is_dir() and not source.is_symlink() and not archive.exists() and not partial.exists() and not manifest.exists()
    before=inventory(source)
    manifest.write_text(json.dumps(before,indent=2)+'\n')
    with tarfile.open(partial,'w:gz',compresslevel=1,dereference=False) as tar:
        for name,row in before.items():
            def metadata(info):
                n=row['mtimeNs'];info.pax_headers['mtime']=f'{n//10**9}.{n%10**9:09d}'
                return info
            tar.add(directory/name,arcname=name,recursive=False,filter=metadata)
    with partial.open('rb') as f: os.fsync(f.fileno())
    seen=set()
    with tarfile.open(partial,'r:gz') as tar:
        for member in tar:
            assert member.name in before and member.name not in seen,member.name
            seen.add(member.name);row=before[member.name]
            assert member.mode==row['mode'] and member.uid==row['uid'] and member.gid==row['gid']
            assert int(decimal.Decimal(member.pax_headers.get('mtime',str(member.mtime)))*10**9)==row['mtimeNs']
            if row['type']=='file':
                assert member.isfile() or member.islnk()
                with tar.extractfile(member) as f: assert sha_stream(f)==row['sha256']
            elif row['type']=='symlink': assert member.issym() and member.linkname==row['link']
            else: assert member.isdir()
    assert seen==set(before)
    assert inventory(source)==before,'Source changed during archival'
    partial.rename(archive)
    item={'campaign':str(directory),'executionSha256':sha(execution),'source':str(source),
          'treeManifest':str(manifest),'treeManifestSha256':sha(manifest),'archive':str(archive),'archiveSha256':sha(archive),
          'archiveBytes':archive.stat().st_size,'uncompressedBytes':sum(r.get('size',0) for r in before.values()),
          'entries':len(before),'verifiedEveryFileAndLink':True,'phase':'verified'}
    report['sources'].append(item);save()
    shutil.rmtree(source);item['phase']='archived';save()
    print(json.dumps({k:item[k] for k in ['campaign','uncompressedBytes','archiveBytes','entries']}),flush=True)
report['finishedAt']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();save()
